prerequisites: Basic knowledge of general English grammatical structures.
Familiarity with technical terms specific to their field of study.

learning_outcomes.text: Communicate effectively in English in a professional context, both orally and in writing.
Present work to an audience using appropriate visual aids.
Demonstrate mastery of the English language aimed at CEFR B2/C1 levels.
Integrate into an international environment and interact with English-speaking interlocutors in a clear and professional manner.
Prepare for the oral and written expression tests required to satisfy the assessment of the four skills.

syllabus_topics: Drafting of e-mails and documents related to professional integration (cover letters and CVs in English)
Participation in and facilitation of business meetings
Study of technical texts (manuals, guides, engineering reports)
Analysis of practical cases related to the students' field of specialization
Writing technical reports and summaries of scientific articles
Preparation and simulation of recruitment interviews in English
Role-playing: negotiations, teamwork, technical project presentations
teaching_methods: Completion of a technical or scientific project requiring the use of English (report and presentation)
E-learning platforms for independent work (interactive exercises, quizzes)
bibliography: Specific resources available at the UTTOP library
Specific resources available online on the advice of teachers
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
